topic.zh: 计算机网络：从一根会出错的线搭到今天的互联网
topic.en: Computer networks: from one faulty wire up to today's internet

learner.zh: 不假设任何 IT 基础：比特、二进制数、「协议」这个词都在游戏里从头讲起。
learner.en: No IT background assumed: bits, binary numbers and the word “protocol” are all taught from scratch.

endpoint.zh: 在模拟世界里打开一个网页，跑的全是自己搭的东西：网卡、交换机、路由器、路由协议、可靠传输、拥塞控制、解析器、HTTP、TLS、QUIC，并能看清每一层在每一拍做了什么。
endpoint.en: Open a web page in the simulated world running only what the player built: network card, switch, router, routing protocol, reliable transport, congestion control, resolver, HTTP, TLS and QUIC, and see what every layer does at every tick.

scope.zh: 这份蓝图只写第 1 代「一根线」：两头之间一根逐拍送位、会翻位的线，从传一位走到一块能装到线两头的网卡。第 0 代（纸笔）的内容并进第 1 代用得着它的关，或推迟到用得着它的那一代；第 2–11 代只记一句，留待后续。
scope.en: This blueprint covers era 1, “One wire”: one wire between two ends carrying a bit a tick and flipping some, from passing on a bit to a network card that sits at both ends. What era 0 (paper and pencil) teaches is folded into the era-1 levels that need it, or deferred to the era that first needs it; eras 2–11 get one line each, for later.

why.zh: 这一代的内容全是时间里的事：位一拍一拍地到，晚到，要数拍、记住前几拍、在一串位里找开头。板每拍跑一遍，寄存卡跨拍保存，正好就是真实网卡里的移位寄存器和计数器。
why.en: Everything in this era happens in time: bits arrive one a tick and late, and the board must count ticks, remember earlier ones and find where a run begins. A board run every tick with registers across ticks is exactly the shift register and counter inside a real network card.

about.zh: 节点接在点对点的线上：每根线从一头把位逐拍送到另一头，过若干拍才到；没人说话时线上是 0。板上每根进来的线一个「线」元件，每根出去的线一个「说」元件。
about.en: A node sits on point-to-point wires: each wire carries one end's bits, a tick at a time, to the other end some ticks later; a wire nobody drives reads 0. A board has a line card for each wire coming in and a say card for each wire going out.

lacks.zh: 线只有两头，一拍只送一位：第三个人没有地方接，整帧也只能一位一位地走。第 2 代把线换成大家都挂在上面的总线，线两头装上网卡，一拍送一段。
lacks.en: A wire has two ends and carries a bit a tick: a third station has nowhere to plug in, and a frame crawls along bit by bit. Era 2 turns it into a bus everyone hangs on, with a network card at each end and a chunk sent per tick.

about.zh: 世界按拍推进：每一拍，板读一次进来的线，说一次出去的线；一根线一拍只送一位。
about.en: The world advances in ticks: each tick the board reads its incoming wires once and says on its outgoing wires once; a wire carries one bit a tick.

wall.zh: 起点：没有它，线上什么也不会发生。
wall.en: The starting point: without it nothing happens on the wire.

about.zh: 按一个条件在两路之间选一路：非、与、或都由选择接出。
about.en: Picking one of two values by a condition: not, and, or are all wired from it.

wall.zh: 传话的板只能原样照搬，要把一位反过来、或按另一根线决定说什么，就做不到。
wall.en: A relay can only copy; it cannot flip a bit or let another wire decide what is said.

about.zh: 寄存卡把一个值留到下一拍。
about.en: A register keeps a value for the next tick.

wall.zh: 板每拍从头算，算完什么也不留：「说出上一拍听到的」这样的规格无从满足。
wall.en: The board starts afresh every tick and keeps nothing: “say what you heard the tick before” cannot be met.

about.zh: 寄存卡加上加法就是数拍的计数器，能清零重来。
about.en: A register and an adder make a counter of ticks that can restart.

wall.zh: 要知道这一拍该发一个字节的第几位、已经收了几位，就得知道过了几拍；只记一拍的寄存卡不够。
wall.en: To know which bit of a byte is due, or how many bits have come in, the board must know how many ticks have passed; one remembered tick is not enough.

about.zh: 一个字节是 8 位二进制数，每一位的分量是后一位的两倍：从高位起逐位说出，收的一方每收一位就把已有的数翻倍再加上它。
about.en: A byte is an 8-bit binary number, each place worth twice the next: it is said from the top bit down, and the receiver doubles what it holds and adds each new bit.

wall.zh: 一根线一拍只能送一位，要送的却是 0 到 255 的数：数得先拆成位，到了再拼回去。
wall.en: A wire carries one bit a tick, but what must go across is a number from 0 to 255: it has to be taken apart into bits and put back together.

about.zh: 线空着时是 0；发送方先说一个 1（起始位）宣布字节开始，每个字节后跟一个 0（停止位）。
about.en: An idle wire reads 0; the sender says a 1 (the start bit) to announce a byte, and ends each byte with a 0 (the stop bit).

wall.zh: 发送方随时可能开口，以 0 开头的字节和空着的线分不出来：收的一方不知道从哪一拍开始数。
wall.en: The sender may begin at any tick, and a byte that starts with 0s looks like an idle wire: the receiver cannot tell where to start counting.

about.zh: 旗标 01111110 标出一帧的开头和结尾，收的一方在任何时候都能从位流里认出它。
about.en: The flag 01111110 marks where a frame begins and ends, and the receiver can spot it in the bit stream at any point.

wall.zh: 一帧有几个字节事先不知道：只靠起始位，收的一方分得出字节，分不出哪几个字节是一帧。
wall.en: How many bytes a frame holds is not known in advance: start bits separate bytes but not frames.

about.zh: 位填充：帧的内容里每连着 5 个 1，发送方就多说一个 0，收的一方再把它去掉，内容里就不会出现旗标。
about.en: Bit stuffing: after every five 1s in a frame's content the sender adds a 0 and the receiver takes it out again, so the content never looks like a flag.

wall.zh: 内容里本身就有 01111110 时，收的一方把它当成旗标，一帧被从中间切断。
wall.en: When the content itself holds 01111110, the receiver takes it for a flag and the frame is cut in two.

about.zh: 发送方按约好的规则在数据后面附几位校验位，收的一方按同一规则核对，就知道数据在线上有没有被改。
about.en: The sender appends a few check bits by an agreed rule and the receiver checks them by the same rule, so it can tell whether the data changed on the way.

wall.zh: 线开始翻位以后，收到的字节错了，收的一方却毫不知情，照样交出去。
wall.en: Once the wire flips bits, a byte arrives wrong and the receiver hands it on without knowing.

about.zh: 把一串位当作一个大数，用不进位的除法（每一步是异或）除以约好的生成式，余数就是校验码；逐拍做时，寄存卡里的几位就是除到一半的余数（CRC）。
about.en: A run of bits is read as one big number and divided, without carries (each step an XOR), by an agreed generator; the remainder is the check. Done tick by tick, the bits in the registers are the remainder so far (CRC).

wall.zh: 奇偶校验位只查得出奇数个错位：恰好翻两位时，校验照样相符。
wall.en: A parity bit catches only an odd number of flipped bits: with exactly two flipped, it still checks out.

about.zh: 分层：网卡对上面只收发整帧，对下面只收发位；上面不必知道旗标、填充和校验码。
about.en: Layering: the card deals in whole frames with the layer above and in bits with the wire below; the layer above never sees flags, stuffing or check bits.

wall.zh: 发帧、收帧、查错分在几块板上，每一个要用线的节点都得把它们重新接一遍。
wall.en: Sending frames, receiving them and checking them sit on separate boards, and every node that uses a wire must wire them up again.

about.zh: 选择：条件为是取一路，否则取另一路。
about.en: Select: one value when the condition holds, the other otherwise.

why.zh: 传话的板只有线和说；没有任何元件能按条件改变一个值，选择是所有逻辑的起点。
why.en: A relay board has only the line and the say card; nothing can change a value by a condition, and select is where all logic starts.

about.zh: 常数：给出设定的数。
about.en: Constant: the number it is set to.

why.zh: 线上和输入只给出变化的值；要说一个固定的 0 或 1，只能由常数给出。
why.en: Wires and inputs give only changing values; a fixed 0 or 1 can come only from a constant.

about.zh: 读寄存卡：同名寄存卡里存的值，存入之前给初值。
about.en: Register: what the register of the same name holds, its start value before.

why.zh: 板每拍从头算；跨拍的状态只能由寄存卡这一对元件保存，任何组合都接不出来。
why.en: The board starts afresh each tick; state across ticks can be held only by the register pair, and no wiring makes it.

about.zh: 存寄存卡：把接入的值存进同名寄存卡，下一拍读得出。
about.en: Keep: stores its input in the register of the same name, readable from the next tick.

why.zh: 同上：它和读寄存卡是一对，写入跨拍的状态。
why.en: As for the register: it is the other half of the pair, writing state across ticks.

about.zh: 相加：两个数之和（加一就是加上常数 1）。
about.en: Add: the sum of two numbers (adding one is adding the constant 1).

why.zh: 手上的元件只能选、只能存，不能让一个数变大；数拍、把收到的位拼成数都要它。
why.en: The parts in hand can only pick and store; none makes a number grow, and both counting and assembling bits into a number need it.

about.zh: 相等：两个数相等为是，否则为否。
about.en: Equal: yes when two numbers are the same, no otherwise.

why.zh: 计数器给出的是数，选择要的是是或否；用手上的元件比较两个多位的数，要把每一位拆出来逐位比，拆位的元件这时还没有。
why.en: A counter gives a number and select wants yes or no; comparing two multi-bit numbers from the parts in hand would need taking them apart bit by bit, which nothing in hand can do.

about.zh: 取位：一个 8 位数从最高位数起的第 i 位。
about.en: Bit of: bit i of an 8-bit number, counted from the top.

why.zh: 加法和相等只能把数变大、比是否相同，不能从一个数里取出某一位；发送一个字节必须一位一位地取。
why.en: Adding and comparing can make a number grow and test sameness, but not reach into a number for one bit; sending a byte means taking it bit by bit.

about.zh: 异或：两位不同为 1，相同为 0。
about.en: XOR: 1 when two bits differ, 0 when they agree.

about.zh: 计数器：自「重来」上一次为 1 起过了几拍。
about.en: Counter: how many ticks since restart was last 1.

about.zh: 移位发送：从「开始」那一拍起，用 8 拍把一个字节从最高位起逐位说出，送完时报一声。
about.en: Shift out: from the start tick, says a byte bit by bit from the top over 8 ticks, and signals when done.

about.zh: 按字节收：逐拍收进位，收满 8 位的那一拍给出这个字节。
about.en: Shift in: takes in a bit a tick and gives the byte on the tick the eighth bit arrives.

about.zh: 成帧器：把上面交来的一帧字节送出，前后加旗标，内容里做位填充。
about.en: Framer: sends a frame of bytes handed down, with a flag at each end and the content bit-stuffed.

about.zh: 拆帧器：在位流里认出旗标之间的帧，去掉填充的 0，逐个给出内容字节，帧结束时报一声。
about.en: Deframer: finds the frame between flags in the bit stream, takes out the stuffed 0s, gives the content bytes one by one and signals the frame's end.

about.zh: CRC：到这一拍为止收进的位串除以生成式（不进位）的余数，能清零重来。
about.en: CRC: the carry-less remainder, by the generator, of the bits taken in so far; it can restart.

about.zh: 网卡：上面交来的帧带上校验码成帧送到线上；线上收到的帧拆开、核对，完好的交给上面。
about.en: Network card: frames handed down go on the wire framed with their check; frames off the wire are unwrapped and checked, and the intact ones go up.

question.zh: 一根一拍送一位、还会出错的线，怎样让两头可靠地交换一帧？
question.en: How do two ends exchange a frame over a wire that carries a bit a tick and gets some wrong?

why.zh: 起点是一根线：两头约好 0 和 1，什么格式都还没有。这一代从照搬一位开始，一层层装出能发能收、能查错的网卡。纸笔一代教的几件事并进第一次用得着它们的关：两种状态在传话，二进制数在逐位发送和接收。
why.en: It starts from one wire: the ends agree on 0 and 1 and nothing else. The era begins by copying a bit and builds up, layer by layer, a card that sends, receives and checks. What the paper era taught goes into the first levels that need it: two states into passing a bit on, binary numbers into sending and gathering a byte.

task.zh: 每一拍把左边线上听到的位说到右边的线上。
task.en: Every tick, say on the right-hand wire the bit heard on the left-hand wire.

task.zh: 每一拍把听到的位反过来说出去：听到 1 说 0，听到 0 说 1。
task.en: Every tick, say the opposite of the bit you hear: 0 for 1, 1 for 0.

task.zh: 听两根线：两根线上的位不同时说 1，相同时说 0。
task.en: Listen to two wires: say 1 when their bits differ and 0 when they agree.

task.zh: 每一拍说出上一拍听到的位；第一拍说 0。
task.en: Every tick, say the bit heard the tick before; say 0 on the first tick.

task.zh: 线上出现 1 之前一直说 0；出现过 1 以后，每一拍都说 1。
task.en: Say 0 until a 1 has come down the wire, and 1 on every tick after that.

task.zh: 输出自「重来」上一次为 1 起已经过了几拍。
task.en: Output how many ticks have passed since restart was last 1.

task.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起，用 8 拍把输入的字节从最高位起逐位说到线上，之后说 0。
task.en: From the tick start is 1, say the input byte on the wire bit by bit from the top over 8 ticks, then say 0.

task.zh: 线上从第一拍起连续送来 8 位（最高位在前），收满 8 位的那一拍输出这个字节。
task.en: Eight bits come down the wire from the first tick, top bit first; output the byte on the tick the eighth arrives.

task.zh: 对方随时可能先说一个 1，再送 8 位；每收到一个字节就输出它。
task.en: At any tick the far end may say a 1 and then 8 bits; output each byte as it arrives.

task.zh: 把交来的几个字节依次送出，每个字节前加起始位 1，后加停止位 0。
task.en: Send the bytes handed to you one after another, each with a start bit 1 before it and a stop bit 0 after.

task.zh: 线上连续送来位；每当最近收到的 8 位是 01111110，就在那一拍说 1。
task.en: Bits keep coming down the wire; say 1 on every tick at which the last 8 bits read 01111110.

task.zh: 把交来的一帧字节送出：前后各加旗标 01111110，内容里每连着 5 个 1 就多说一个 0。
task.en: Send the frame of bytes handed to you with a flag 01111110 at each end, adding a 0 after every five 1s in the content.

task.zh: 从线上认出旗标之间的一帧，去掉塞进的 0，逐个输出内容字节，帧结束的那一拍报一声。
task.en: Find the frame between flags on the wire, take out the stuffed 0s, output the content bytes one by one and signal on the tick the frame ends.

task.zh: 每个字节后面跟一个奇偶校验位，线会翻位；输出收到的每个字节，并说出它的校验是否相符。
task.en: Each byte is followed by a parity bit and the wire flips bits; output each byte received and say whether its parity checks out.

task.zh: 每一拍输出到这一拍为止收到的位串不进位地除以 1011 的余数；「重来」为 1 时从头算起。
task.en: Every tick, output the carry-less remainder of the bits received so far divided by 1011; start over when restart is 1.

task.zh: 把交来的字节送出，紧接着送出它的 3 位校验码。
task.en: Send the byte handed to you, followed at once by its 3 check bits.

task.zh: 线会翻位：从线上收帧，逐个输出内容字节，帧结束时说出这一帧是否完好。
task.en: The wire flips bits: receive frames, output their content bytes one by one, and say at each frame's end whether it arrived intact.

task.zh: 搭一块网卡：上面交来的帧带上校验码送到线上，线上收到的完好的帧交给上面；线的两头装着同一块网卡。
task.en: Build a network card: frames handed down go on the wire with their check, and intact frames off the wire go up; the same card sits at both ends of the wire.

task.zh: 两根线之间装两块网卡，把左边收到的完好的帧从右边转发出去。
task.en: Put two network cards between two wires and forward every intact frame from the left wire onto the right.

task.zh: 每块 4 位数据后面跟 3 位校验码（生成式 1011），线上最多翻一位；输出改正后的 4 位数据。
task.en: Each 4-bit block is followed by 3 check bits (generator 1011) and the wire flips at most one bit; output the corrected 4 data bits.

naive.zh: 原样输出收到的数据位：没有翻位时都对，所以看起来过得去；一旦有一位翻了就错，余数只被用来判好坏，没有用来找出是哪一位。
naive.en: Output the data bits as received: right whenever nothing flipped, so it looks fine, but wrong as soon as one bit flips; the remainder is only used to judge, not to find which bit it was.

why.zh: 起始位和旗标是找出开头的两种办法，互不依赖：起始位分出单个字节，旗标分出整帧。后面的查错和网卡建在旗标上，起始位是这一代对「从哪开始」的第一个回答。
why.en: Start bits and flags are two independent answers to where things begin: start bits mark single bytes, flags whole frames. Error checking and the card build on flags; start bits are the era's first answer to where a byte starts.

about.zh: 点对点的线：每根线把一头说的位过 d 拍送到另一头，没人说时为 0；关卡写出拓扑（几根线、板在哪一头听或说），世界的节点在线的另一头按测试说位或听位，板上每根进来的线一个线元件、每根出去的线一个说元件。
about.en: Point-to-point wires: each carries the bits one end says to the other end d ticks later, 0 when nobody speaks; a level names its wires and which end the board hears or says on, world nodes at the far ends say or hear the test's bits, and the board has a line card per incoming wire and a say card per outgoing one.

about.zh: 原始元件选择、相加、相等、取位（8 位数从最高位起的第 i 位），碰到「—」给「—」。
about.en: The primitives select, add, equal and bit-of (bit i of an 8-bit number from the top), giving 「—」 for 「—」.

about.zh: 输出的要求：逐拍写定的值（含「—」）；只比非「—」值的先后、不比时刻的值序列；以及线另一头的世界节点按约定的格式（裸位、起止位、旗标、旗标加 CRC）解出收到的字节，必须等于要送的内容。
about.en: What outputs must be: values fixed tick by tick (「—」 included); the order of the non-「—」 values, timing aside; and what a world node at the far end decodes by an agreed format (raw bits, start/stop, flags, flags with CRC), which must equal what was to be sent.

about.zh: 可以拉取的输入：关卡给一列字节（可分成几帧），板在一拍里说「下一个」，下一拍这一项出现在输入上，取完给「—」，帧与帧之间给出帧界。
about.en: An input the board pulls from: the level gives a list of bytes (possibly in frames); when the board asks for the next one, it appears on the input the following tick, 「—」 once used up, with frame boundaries marked.

about.zh: 会翻位的线：测试可以写定在哪几拍翻位（给隐藏测试用），也可以按出错率带种子随机翻位，在几个种子下各跑一遍。
about.en: A wire that flips bits: a test may name the ticks at which it flips (for hidden tests) or flip at random by an error rate with a seed, run over several seeds.

about.zh: 搭出元件的板把它的线元件和说元件也作为元件的口，一个节点可以放几块（中继里的两块网卡）；关卡可以让玩家的同一块板跑在一根线的两头，各有各的寄存卡。
about.en: A board that builds a part exposes its line and say cards as the part's ports, so one node can hold several (two cards in a relay); a level may run the player's board at both ends of a wire, each copy with its own registers.

about.zh: 第 0 代「纸笔」的四关手做关
about.en: Era 0, “Paper and pencil”, four manual levels

why.zh: 逐拍总线领域和盲玩 harness 都不支持手动关。两种状态并进 1-1，二进制数并进逐位发送和接收；字符对照表推迟到第 9 代的文本协议，那里第一次非它不可；长度前缀推迟到第 5 代的字节流分帧，理由同上。
why.en: Neither the tick-bus domain nor the blind-play harness supports manual levels. Two states go into 1-1, binary numbers into sending and gathering a byte; the character table waits for era 9's text protocols, where it is first indispensable, and the length prefix for era 5's framing on a byte stream, for the same reason.

about.zh: 设计稿里的机关台「晚到」（传播时间和发送时间）
about.en: The design sketch's bench “Arriving late” (propagation and transmission time)

why.zh: 这一代一拍送一位，发送时间还不是一回事，晚到在 1-1 的时序图里就看得见；它放到第 2 代整帧占线若干拍时。参数台盲玩也还不支持。
why.en: With a bit a tick, transmission time does not yet matter, and arriving late shows in 1-1's timeline; it goes to era 2, where a frame holds the wire for several ticks. Blind play does not support benches yet either.

about.zh: 设计稿的挑战「数据里正好有旗标」和网卡系列的前三关
about.en: The sketch's challenge “The data holds a flag” and the card series' first three levels

why.zh: 内容里出现旗标正是位填充那一关撞上的墙，做成挑战就成了新机制；送一句话、送几句话、线会出错只是重做 1-7 到 1-17，没有新维度，网卡一关直接站在已搭出的元件上。
why.en: A flag inside the content is the very wall of the stuffing level, so as a challenge it would bring a new mechanism; sending one message, several, and over a noisy wire only redo 1-7 to 1-17 with no new dimension, so the card level stands directly on the parts already built.

about.zh: 第 2 代 · 局域网
about.en: Era 2 · LAN

why.zh: 总线、地址、撞车与退避、交换机、生成树；要整帧的线和网卡收进线里，等第 1 代上线后再写。
why.en: Bus, addresses, collisions and backoff, switches, spanning tree; needs whole-frame wires with the card folded into them, written once era 1 is live.

about.zh: 第 3 代 · 网际
about.en: Era 3 · Internetwork

why.zh: 分层地址、路由器、报头校验（重复框）、最长前缀、ARP、TTL；要重复框，后续再写。
why.en: Hierarchical addresses, routers, header checksum (repeat frame), longest prefix, ARP, TTL; needs the repeat frame, for later.

about.zh: 第 4 代 · 自己算路
about.en: Era 4 · Routing itself

why.zh: 距离向量和链路状态两路并行，再到路径向量；建在第 3 代的路由器上。
why.en: Distance vector and link state in parallel, then path vector; builds on era 3's router.

about.zh: 第 5 代 · 端到端
about.en: Era 5 · End to end

why.zh: 端口、停等、滑动窗口、RTT 估计、握手、字节流分帧（长度前缀在这里）；兑现第 1 代「只查不补」。
why.en: Ports, stop-and-wait, sliding window, RTT estimation, handshake, framing a byte stream (the length prefix lives here); it cashes in era 1's detect-but-do-not-resend.

about.zh: 第 6 代 · 拥挤
about.en: Era 6 · Congestion

why.zh: AIMD、拥塞窗口、慢启动、快重传、队列管理；要曲线视图和代价度量。
why.en: AIMD, congestion window, slow start, fast retransmit, queue management; needs curve views and cost measures.

about.zh: 第 7 代 · 地址
about.en: Era 7 · Addresses

why.zh: DHCP、NAT，可选的 IPv6；建在第 3、5 代上。
why.en: DHCP, NAT, optional IPv6; builds on eras 3 and 5.

about.zh: 第 8 代 · 名字
about.en: Era 8 · Names

why.zh: 分层的名字、逐步解析、缓存与否定缓存，搭出解析器；建在第 5 代上。
why.en: Hierarchical names, iterative resolution, caching and negative caching, building a resolver; builds on era 5.

about.zh: 第 9 代 · 网页
about.en: Era 9 · The web

why.zh: 文本请求与响应（字符表在这里）、长度与分块、持久连接、Cookie、缓存；建在第 5、8 代上。
why.en: Text requests and responses (the character table lives here), length and chunking, persistent connections, cookies, caching; builds on eras 5 and 8.

about.zh: 第 10 代 · 保密
about.en: Era 10 · Secrecy

why.zh: 一次一密、Diffie–Hellman（模幂）、签名、证书、消息认证、TLS；要乘法与取模。
why.en: One-time pad, Diffie–Hellman (modular power), signatures, certificates, message authentication, TLS; needs multiply and modulo.

about.zh: 第 11 代 · 现代
about.en: Era 11 · Modern

why.zh: 多路复用、队头阻塞、QUIC、任播；全书终点，几乎只用前面搭出的元件。
why.en: Multiplexing, head-of-line blocking, QUIC, anycast; the course's endpoint, standing almost only on parts built before.
